title: High-activity wallet
description: One wallet with 1000 in-range transactions over 90 days, bursty (max 65 txs in one day), mixing SOL and USDC transfers in/out, fake-program swaps between USDC and a fake mint, and ~2% failed transactions.
notes: rpc.json is intentionally NOT written to disk for this scenario (several MB). Tests must call generateHighActivity() from fixtures/solana/synthetic/generate.ts with the options above to obtain { manifest, rpc }.
getSignaturesForAddress is recorded as 2 pages (limit 1000); the first page starts with 3 transactions newer than range.end and the last page contains 5 transactions older than range.start.
Mix (all 1008 generated): SOL in 338, SOL out 274, USDC in 204, USDC out 180, swaps 12; failed 17 (17 in range, all wallet-initiated and fee-only).
Bursts: 8 days with 40+ transactions; 26 days with none.

Fake mint AusZ96intfjPTjhVvewusZwBkuPsUbBrotdc5ZpxKUSQ (5 decimals) and fake swap program 9BEnzRYD6ZsCAC66a1wCqXwz7Fd21UwEp6oJjopcYKyA are synthetic; swaps are unparsed outer instructions with two spl-token transferChecked inner instructions.

Balances are internally consistent: for the wallet, each transaction's postBalances/postTokenBalances equal the next transaction's pre values (per asset); fees are debited from the fee payer, including on failed transactions.
